entries.name: @jarvispieces/piece-jarvis-notify
entries.description: Deliver a message to the user via the configured channels (Telegram, Discord, voice, dashboard, desktop).

notify.name: notify
notify.description: Deliver a message through Jarvis's configured channels. Use 'auto' to let Jarvis pick a sensible default given the priority.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.description: Body of the notification. Supports {{stepName.field}} templates resolved by the engine.

fields.name: channels
fields.label: Channels
fields.description: Empty / [auto] lets Jarvis pick a default fan-out across the user's connected channels.

entries.name: @jarvispieces/piece-jarvis-regex
entries.description: Match, extract, and replace text using JavaScript regular expressions.

match.name: match
match.description: Test whether a string matches a regex pattern. Returns matched + first-match groups.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: The input string. Often a step output template like {{step.body}}.

fields.name: pattern
fields.label: Pattern
fields.description: JavaScript regex. Use parentheses to capture groups. Anchors / flags are inline (e.g. (?i) for case-insensitive).

fields.name: flags
fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Optional regex flags string (i / m / s / u). Leave empty for default.

extract.name: extract
extract.description: Return every match of a regex in a string, with capture groups per match. Suitable as a LOOP_ON_ITEMS source.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: The input string to scan.

fields.name: pattern
fields.label: Pattern
fields.description: JavaScript regex. The `g` flag is enforced -- every match is returned, not just the first one.

fields.name: flags
fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Optional regex flags (i / m / s / u). The `g` flag is added automatically.

replace.name: replace
replace.description: Substitute regex matches in a string with a replacement (supports $1 / $& back-references).

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: The input string.

fields.name: pattern
fields.label: Pattern
fields.description: JavaScript regex. With `g` flag (added automatically), every match is replaced; without, only the first.

fields.name: replacement
fields.label: Replacement
fields.description: Replacement string. Use $1 / $2 to reference capture groups, $& for the full match. Empty string deletes the matches.

fields.name: flags
fields.label: Flags
fields.description: Optional regex flags (i / m / s / u). The `g` flag is added automatically -- pass an empty value to disable global replace by setting just the modifiers you want.

fields.name: onlyFirst
fields.label: Replace only the first match
fields.description: When ON, drop the `g` flag so only the first match is replaced.

entries.name: @jarvispieces/piece-jarvis-ask
entries.description: Send a prompt to the daemon's LLM and receive the reply.

ask.name: ask
ask.description: Send a prompt to Jarvis's LLM and receive the reply. A step that asks for JSON fails when the reply misses that contract, unless the graph explicitly handles the outcome.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: The user prompt to send to the LLM.

fields.name: system
fields.label: System
fields.description: Extra system instructions APPENDED to the standard Jarvis system prompt. Use this to bias the reply (e.g. "answer in JSON"). Turn on Override to replace the Jarvis prompt entirely instead.

fields.name: overrideSystem
fields.label: Override Jarvis system prompt
fields.description: When ON, the System field above becomes the ONLY system prompt -- Jarvis's identity, role, personality, and vault context are not sent. Use for generic LLM tasks (text transforms, summarisation of plain inputs) where Jarvis context would bias the reply. Leave OFF (default) when you want the model to answer as Jarvis.

fields.name: parseJson
fields.label: Parse JSON
fields.description: Require the reply to be JSON. `parsed` carries the parsed value and the step fails on a reply that is not JSON, unless Require valid output is off. The reply must be bare JSON: no code fences, no commentary.

fields.name: outputSchema
fields.label: Output schema (JSON)
fields.description: Optional JSON Schema the parsed reply must match. Supported keywords: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum. Any other keyword is refused before the prompt is sent. Implies Parse JSON. Describe the shape in the prompt as well: the schema checks the reply, it does not steer the model.

fields.name: requireSuccess
fields.label: Require valid output
fields.description: Stop the step when the reply misses the JSON or schema contract. Turn off only when a later step routes on {{step.outcome.status}} and handles the failure itself; `text` is still returned, `parsed` is not. On a failure, `outcome` also carries `code` and `message`.

outputSample.text: Here's a one-line summary of your inbox: ...

entries.name: @jarvispieces/piece-jarvis-trigger
entries.description: Bridge Jarvis events into workflows (on_event trigger) and run saved workflows from inside other workflows (run_workflow action).

run_workflow.name: run_workflow
run_workflow.description: Trigger a saved workflow by id. Returns the started run id. Fire-and-forget; the called workflow runs asynchronously.

fields.name: flow
fields.label: Flow
fields.description: Pick a workflow to run.

fields.name: payload
fields.label: Payload
fields.description: Optional JSON object passed as the trigger payload of the called flow.

on_event.name: on_event
on_event.description: Fire the workflow when a Jarvis event of the given type is published. Use the daemon's event-type catalog (awareness.*, commitment.*, voice.*, tool.*) to pick a value.

fields.name: eventType
fields.label: Event type
fields.description: Fully-qualified Jarvis event type (e.g. awareness.context_changed).

options.label: observer.clipboard_changed
options.description: User copied something. The clipboard text is at `payload.content` (reference as {{trigger.payload.content}}); also `payload.length`. There is NO type/kind field -- detect what it is by inspecting `payload.content` itself (e.g. regex-match against ^https?:// to decide it's a URL). Do not test for a `contentType`.

options.label: observer.file_changed
options.description: A watched file or directory changed. The path is at `payload.path` ({{trigger.payload.path}}); the kind of change is at `payload.eventType` (created / modified / deleted). Also `payload.filename`, `payload.basePath`.

options.label: observer.email_received
options.description: New Gmail message arrived (requires Google auth). The available content is `payload.snippet` ({{trigger.payload.snippet}}, a short preview) -- there is NO full email body, so feed `payload.snippet` into any classification/summary prompt. Other fields: `payload.from`, `payload.to`, `payload.subject`, `payload.date`, `payload.labels`, `payload.id`, `payload.threadId`.

options.label: observer.calendar_event_starting
options.description: A Google Calendar event is about to start. Title at `payload.summary` ({{trigger.payload.summary}}); start time at `payload.start`.

options.label: observer.process_started
options.description: A new process appeared in the process list. Pid at `payload.pid`; name at `payload.name` ({{trigger.payload.name}}).

options.label: observer.process_stopped
options.description: A previously-running process exited. Pid at `payload.pid`; name at `payload.name` ({{trigger.payload.name}}).

options.label: observer.notification_received
options.description: A D-Bus / native desktop notification was shown. Source app at `payload.app` ({{trigger.payload.app}}); also `payload.title`, `payload.body`, `payload.urgency`.

options.label: commitment.due_soon
options.description: A commitment is about to come due (typically within the next 30 min). Text at `payload.what` ({{trigger.payload.what}}); id at `payload.id`; due ms at `payload.when_due`.

options.label: commitment.overdue
options.description: A commitment passed its due time without being completed. Text at `payload.what` ({{trigger.payload.what}}); id at `payload.id`; due ms at `payload.when_due`.

options.label: awareness.context_changed
options.description: User switched between meaningful contexts (project / app / task). Active app at `payload.app` ({{trigger.payload.app}}); project at `payload.project`.

options.label: awareness.error_detected
options.description: User is hitting an error pattern detected by the awareness service. Error text at `payload.excerpt` ({{trigger.payload.excerpt}}); originating app at `payload.app`.

options.label: awareness.stuck_detected
options.description: User has been on the same window for too long with little change. App at `payload.app`; window title at `payload.windowTitle` ({{trigger.payload.windowTitle}}); duration ms at `payload.durationMs`.

options.label: awareness.struggle_detected
options.description: User is undoing repeatedly or otherwise showing struggle signals. App at `payload.app`; specific signal name at `payload.signal` ({{trigger.payload.signal}}).

options.label: awareness.session_started
options.description: A new awareness session began (focus on a project or task). Session id at `payload.sessionId`; topic at `payload.topic` (may be null at start).

options.label: awareness.session_ended
options.description: An awareness session ended. Inferred topic at `payload.topic` ({{trigger.payload.topic}}); duration ms at `payload.durationMs`; session id at `payload.sessionId`.

options.label: awareness.suggestion_ready
options.description: Awareness intelligence produced a proactive suggestion for the user. Title at `payload.title` ({{trigger.payload.title}}); body at `payload.body`.

fields.name: filter
fields.label: Filter
fields.description: Optional shallow-equality filter; each field must match the event payload exactly.
